calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'

SELECT MIN(join_date) AS earliest_join, MAX(join_date) AS latest_join, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_distinct_members
FROM dim_member

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_join_dates
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date IS NULL

SELECT join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-05'
GROUP BY join_date
ORDER BY join_date
